property_summary: For any call to C.fallback sending exactly 10 ether with a strictly later block.timestamp, the reference contract transfers its entire balance to msg.sender iff block.number % 15 == 0 (so when block.number % 15 == 0 the contract balance becomes zero afterward); the mutant inverts this condition and thus for some block numbers the post-call balance differs (nonzero vs zero).
change_summary: Invert the block number divisibility condition so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0 instead of == 0.
